svg.title: PathPilot QuPath 0.8 workflow with knowledge-assisted TLS candidate search
svg.desc: Updated 25 November 2026 from the 24 November test: native full-image detection, knowledge-assisted AI code generation, human review, frozen snapshot, independent Python audit, and distance-density candidate screening. 3720 cells, 11 candidate clusters, 3 exploratory curve matches.

g.text: From Generated Script to Audited Result
PathPilot: Knowledge-Assisted Code Generation, TLS Search and Audited Quantification
🔒 Slide pixels & cell data stay local
Confirm panel, card versions and scope
Definitions: off by default; TLS asks consent
optional: marker rules, knowledge, spatial / TLS
Edits revoke consent • Invalid JSON blocks approval
Explicit rules, thresholds and analysis scope
Reference cases and answers stay local
Task fields + source context → single JSON response
▶ Harness records inputs before the API call
The request includes task fields and source context
Host checks files, scope and inputs before execution
Freeze ROI / same-plane cells and calibrated centroids
Run independent local test cases first in wrapper
Run candidate analysis on the frozen snapshot
Inspect full saved script in the native Script Editor
No OS sandbox • Runs with QuPath process privileges
Snapshot binds scope geometry, cell IDs and measurements
Missing calibration blocks requested spatial metrics
• Cell ROI centroids: boundary in, holes out, same z/t
• Spatial inputs: calibrated area (mm²) and centroids (μm)
Hashes bind specification, script and snapshot
One session for skill, request and result records
The receipt records the outcome or failure
Counts • Marker Rules • Spatial Metrics • TLS Curves
TLS: hidden cases + full frozen-snapshot recalculation
Full image on the current Z/T plane
3,720 measured cells in the latest run
TLS scope: selected ROI or up to 5,000 cells
CD20 / CD23 / CD8 + spatial method cards
User approves definitions and full script
Exact Cell mean keys + explicit thresholds
CD23 centroid graph: links within 25 μm
At least 3 objects per connected cluster
11 CD23 clusters found in this real run
10 μm rings to 40 μm; clipped ring areas
Density = count / area; normalize to scope
Fit CD20 and CD8 relative-density slopes
Match: CD20 slope < 0 AND CD8 slope > 0
Rule detail: ≥2 valid rings per marker; zero-area rings excluded; zero baseline → insufficient data; |slope| ≤ 10⁻¹² /μm treated as zero.
Exploratory spatial evidence: curve matches require segmentation, threshold / parameter validation and expert review before diagnostic use.
• Count existing Cell objects in the selected ROI
• Example: CD8 positive and CD23 negative
• Require exact measurement keys and explicit thresholds
• Exclude missing values from the evaluable denominator
• Require X/Y calibration and at most 2,000 cells for NN
• Mean nearest-neighbor distance is null for one cell
• A required measurement key is absent
• Spatial metrics requested without valid calibration
• Modified script, changed ROI/plane, or >2,000 NN cells
PROJECT VALIDATION / 11–24 NOV 2026 · HISTORICAL REFERENCES + CURRENT TLS ENGINEERING CHECKS
NN MAE: 1.664 μm (n=22/23; shares Batch 1 IDs)
150 real calls • Same counts in Groovy 5.0.6 replay
